description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and memory_manager.py to understand the API. 2. Agent `cd`s into `/workspace/memory-manager/` (or uses sys.path manipulation) to import `memory_manager`. 3. Agent calls `record_session()` at least 3 times, using the EXACT field names: `date`, `topics`, `key_info` (not `key_points`!), `todos`, `decisions`, `emotion`. Each call produces a `temp/session_N.md` file. 4. Agent calls `process_temp_files()`, which: aggregates all sessions into `/workspace/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (the proprietary trap — `memory_dir` defaults to `../memory` relative to the script, NOT `./memory`), and deletes all `temp/session_*.md` files. 5. The resulting daily summary at `/workspace/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` must contain 'Sessions Processed: 3' (or more), all four required section headers, bullet items under Topics and Key Information, and no leftover session files in temp/.
